scope: Presentation-only source reuse: regional maritime support and local substrate eligibility replace height-only universal sand/wet paint. No height, frozen erosion, authoritative physics, water classification, roughness algorithm or optional normal-strength change.
root_causes: The old 0..45 m yellow layer ignored ocean context, slope, exposed geology, vegetation, wetland and salt.
The old 0..3 m wet-rim multiplier darkened every near-datum land surface.

Independent review rejected an intermediate correction that mixed sand after partial cover, attenuating the vegetation twice and disagreeing with its roughness/normal weight. Coastal optical treatment now precedes the existing cover stack.

regressions.fractional_cover_test_boundary: Final regression filters the existing vegetation-dependent cover-texture gain at 5000 m to isolate layer opacity. An intermediate unfiltered assertion after the layer move failed because it omitted that pre-existing gain; this was a test-oracle correction, not a second material fix.

independent_review.final_result: No remaining source blockers; partial-cover issue resolved. Coarse maritime support may still admit isolated near-datum inland ground. Source/numerical inspection only, not independent GPU or visual acceptance.

actual_checks.machine_required_bevy_ignored_command: passed but matched zero ignored tests; not hardware coverage

fallback_asset_sync.baseline_build: Exact 3d8698f generator source in a separate target/coastal-reference directory; not the pre-existing release executable.
fallback_asset_sync.initial_export_failure: Wrong body filename thessa_body.toml was rejected before export. Retried successfully with the existing thessa_v02.toml; not a source fix.

page_construction_observations.workload: Existing release material_pages: 512 serial 128x128 pages across six faces and L10..14; 64 close-land normal-off/on paired pages at L14..17.
page_construction_observations.boundary: Non-counterbalanced whole processes under varying concurrent compilation/CPU load. Cost observations only: no speedup or stable before/after ranking. This is not a shoreline scene or frame/loading benchmark.

limits: Regional ocean context has 2-degree meridional spacing: maritime support fades at approximately 111.7..223.4 km, not a precise shoreline or connectivity query.
Altitude, slope and wet-rim parameters are authored optical priors, not measured sediment availability or capillary physics.
Texture differences and passing numeric tests do not establish visual preference, close-surface acceptance, natural geometry or vegetation rendering.
No FPS, whole-client CPU/GPU tail, allocation or RSS/VRAM improvement claim.
readme_check: Existing deterministic worldgen/shared material and incomplete visual acceptance claims remain accurate; no new public CLI in this slice.
